corrections.exactQuote: For Beacon staging verification, run `pnpm beacon:smoke-v2` only after all staging migrations have passed.
corrections.rationale: The source names passed staging migrations, not a separately named preflight. Null is proposed under an explicit-preflight reading; whether migrations count as a preflight is an unresolved field-definition ambiguity for independent review.

corrections.exactQuote: Zephyr deployments require a passing preflight before any apply operation.
corrections.rationale: The source states a general deployment preflight requirement. Unknown local command and resource limits can remain null while this supported requirement remains true.
